quests.title: Tabletop Adventurer

dialogue.t: H—H—Hello, you t—two... My name is... is... A—A—Armand...
S—S—Sorry! I—I get like th—this when th—there are too many... p—p—people around...
No worries, no worries. You don't have to rush, we're just here to try out the toy!
O—Oh. S—S—Sure... I have p—prepared a... h—h—handbook for you...
Aw, that's so nice of you, Armand! We'll read it carefully for sure.
I—It's alright if you d—don't read it. It's very s—s—simple and f—fun... D—Do you want to t—try?

dialogue.sit: Thanks, I'll give it a go.

quests.description: Armand of Lepaute Horlogerie is in charge of taking care of their toys. Go see how you can try those gizmos out…
